title: Over 10 bus drivers, conductors test positive in random drug screening at Maharagama
summary: Thirteen bus drivers and conductors tested positive for narcotic drug use during a surprise screening programme conducted at the Navinna bus stand in Maharagama on Tuesday (23).

title: U.S. donated TH-57 helicopters handed over to Sri Lanka Air Force
summary: Ten TH-57 Sea Ranger multi-purpose helicopters donated by the United States were officially handed over to the Sri Lanka Air Force (SLAF) during a ceremony held at Ratmalana Air Force Base on Monday under the patronage of President Anura Kumara Dissanayake.

title: Namal questions ‘Clean Sri Lanka’ programme amid rising dengue cases
summary: Opposition MP has questioned the effectiveness of the Government’s “Clean Sri Lanka” programme, citing the recent surge in dengue cases across the country.

title: Sri Lanka assumes CASP-AP chairmanship for 2026-2027
summary: Sri Lanka has taken over the chairmanship of the Cooperative Aviation Security Programme – Asia Pacific (CASP-AP) for the 2026–2027 term, further strengthening its role in regional aviation security cooperation.

title: Applications for GIT examination 2026 open until July 16
summary: The Examinations Department has called for applications for the General Information Technology (GIT) Examination 2026, which will be conducted for Grade 12 students in government and private schools.

title: U.S. delivers $4 million satellite communication system to Sri Lanka Navy
summary: The United States has delivered an advanced Fleet Broadband satellite communication system to the Sri Lanka Navy (SLN), enhancing maritime connectivity and operational capabilities across its Offshore Patrol Fleet.

title: Oil prices continue to slide as peace talks progress
summary: Crude oil prices extended their decline today, with Brent crude sliding to $77.51 per barrel at the time of writing, and West Texas Intermediate at $73.62 per barrel, on reports that the United States and Iran were making progress in their peace talks.

title: Police inspector remanded over alleged Rs. 1 million bribery
summary: A Police Inspector attached to the Kalutara Special Crimes Investigation Unit was remanded till July 3 by Colombo Additional Magistrate Lahiru Silva for allegedly accepting Rs. 1 million as part of a bribe demanded to facilitate the release of an illegally assembled van without instituting criminal proceedings.

title: Parliament approves budget proposal to reduce VAT, SSCL threshold
summary: Parliament unanimously approved the proposal to reduce the Value Added Tax (VAT) and the Social Security Contribution Levy (SSCL) from Rs.60 million to Rs.36 million.

title: Supreme Court reserves judgment in FR petition against former Minister Fowzie
summary: The Supreme Court today reserved judgment in a Fundamental Rights petition filed by former Chairman of the Ceylon Chamber of Commerce, Chandra Jayaratne, alleging that the misuse of a government vehicle by former State Minister A.H.M. Fowzie violated the fundamental rights guaranteed under the Constitution.

title: France records hottest-ever night as 40 drown trying to escape heatwave
summary: At least 40 ⁠people have drowned in recent days in France while swimming in unsupervised areas to seek relief from a heatwave gripping the country and other parts of Europe.

title: PACAF Commander meets Deputy Defence Minister
summary: General Kevin B. Schneider, Commander of the United States Pacific Air Forces (PACAF), paid a courtesy call on Sri Lanka’s Deputy Minister of Defence, Major General Aruna Jayasekara (Retd), at the Ministry of Defence in Colombo on Monday as part of his three-day official visit to the country from June 21 to 24.

title: Processed meats, sugary snacks, soft drinks banned from school canteens
summary: The Ministry of Health has announced a list of food items that will be prohibited in school canteens under its newly introduced ’Guidelines on Healthy School Canteens’, aimed at ensuring students have access to affordable, safe and nutritious meals.

title: Woman injured in Wellawa shooting incident
summary: A woman was injured following a shooting incident in the Wellawa area of Kurunegala early this morning (23).

title: North Korea’s Kim doubles down on nuclear buildup
summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un on Tuesday doubled down on Pyongyang’s nuclear weapons buildup and confrontational stance toward Seoul.
